title: A threat against someone’s food
literal_meaning: I will hurt you through your rice, not with my hand.
explanation: The threat is to deprive someone of food or support rather than strike them. It exposes another form of coercion.
meaning_odia: ହାତ ଉଠାଇବା ବଦଳରେ ଖାଇବା ବା ଚଳିବାର ସାହାଯ୍ୟ ବନ୍ଦ କରି କଷ୍ଟ ଦେବାର ଧମକ ଏହା।
usage_example: Someone withholds promised support to punish disagreement; another person identifies the threat. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: Recorded as a saying, not advice or justification for deprivation.

witnesses.note: Exact saying isolated from its explicitly labelled dictionary example; no spelling repair.
